title: Trump Rules Out Further Strikes, Pivots to Economic Pressure on Iran
detail: President Trump signaled the US is shifting from military strikes to economic pressure on Iran, describing ongoing talks as only 'semi-negotiations' and saying Washington is going 'low key.' Trump stated there would be no more strikes on Iran for now, emphasizing that maximum economic sanctions — rather than continued airstrikes — would be the primary tool to compel Iranian concessions on its nuclear program and shipping behavior. The posture shift comes amid a fragile de-escalation following the collapse of the Islamabad MOU in early July 2026 and subsequent resumed US strikes. Trump did not announce a formal ceasefire or diplomatic breakthrough.

media.caption: Trump says US going 'low key,' stresses economic pressure over military operations on Iran
Trump says US is 'only semi-negotiating' with Iran

title: Houthis Attack Saudi Aramco's Jazan Refinery, Claim Strike Near Mokha
detail: Yemen's Iran-backed Houthi movement said it struck Saudi Aramco's Jazan refinery in southwestern Saudi Arabia with a drone, sparking a fire that was extinguished with no injuries reported. The Houthis said the attack was in response to alleged Saudi drone incursions into Saada and Hajjah governorates in Yemen. The 400,000 bpd refinery had already been shut down since a July 27 Houthi attack damaged its gasification complex and tank farm. Hours later, the Houthis separately claimed a 'large-scale' operation targeting Saudi-backed forces near Mokha on Yemen's Red Sea coast.

media.caption: Fire at Aramco's Jazan refinery extinguished after Houthi drone attack claim

title: Khamenei Appoints Former IRGC Chief Mohsen Rezaei as Top Security Council Secretary
detail: Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei issued a decree appointing Mohsen Rezaei, a hardline former commander-in-chief of the IRGC (1981-1997) and Iran-Iraq War veteran, as his personal representative to and secretary of Iran's Supreme National Security Council, replacing Mohammad Bagher Zolghadr in the secretary role. Rezaei, a longtime member of the Expediency Council and senior military adviser to Khamenei, joins fellow hardliner Saeed Jalili as a Khamenei representative on the body that oversees Iran's war strategy and nuclear negotiating position.

media.caption: Mohsen Rezaei named Iran's top security chief and Khamenei representative

title: Pentagon Urges Defense Contractors to Ramp Up Weapons Production Amid Low Stockpiles
detail: The Defense Department sent a memo urging US military contractors to increase production of munitions, citing concerns that American weapons stockpiles are running low after more than five months of sustained operations against Iran. The memo followed Trump's Aug 6 assertion that the US has 'massive amounts' of munitions despite the reported shortfalls, and coincided with reports that the Strategic Petroleum Reserve has fallen below 300 million barrels, its lowest level since 1983.

media.caption: Pentagon memo urges defense contractors to ramp up weapons production
